title: P3 OpenAI Responses Adapter
goal: Implement OpenAI Responses as a strict independent adapter over the P1 streaming contract.

facts.text: The current endpoint resolver and adapter support only /chat/completions.
Pi separates Responses item conversion and streaming event conversion from Chat Completions.
The pinned Pi Responses reducer uses one mutable currentItem/currentBlock pair, while BGSM requires identity-safe handling of interleaved output items.

in: Completed, failed, cancelled and incomplete terminal handling

constraints: Use the shared provider event and aggregation contract.
Track output items by item identity or output index rather than one mutable current item.
Require response.completed for success; response.failed, response.cancelled and unexpected EOF fail closed.
Do not enable server-side persistent conversation state in v1.
Before implementation, review every P3 Pi source listed in docs/plans/agent-provider/pi-source-reference.md at the pinned commit and update its comparison record.
Verify exact event shapes against current official OpenAI API/OpenAPI documentation before implementation; official schemas and stricter BGSM invariants override Pi behavior.

requirements.text: Convert BGSM model history and tools into valid Responses input items.
Convert Responses text and function-call events into normalized stream events.
Normalize usage and terminal outcomes and fail closed on malformed or incomplete responses.
Support prepared single-use final aggregation for OrganizeJob-compatible callers.
Complete the pinned Pi Responses comparison, explicitly record the identity-safe divergence and confirm all wire fields against the current official schema.

acceptance_criteria.text: System, user, assistant, tool calls and tool results round-trip through Responses input without losing call identity.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Request conversion fixtures match the documented schema.

acceptance_criteria.text: Interleaved output text and function-call items assemble by stable identity and produce complete validated tool calls only.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Interleaved item and arbitrary chunk fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Usage and finish reason normalize into ModelResponse; failed, cancelled, incomplete, malformed and EOF-without-completed responses return typed errors.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Terminal and error fixture matrix passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Prepared request bytes remain exact and execute once to a final ModelResponse without requiring a UI subscriber.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Prepared request and OrganizeProposalAnalyzer contract tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: The P3 comparison record names the reviewed Pi commit, confirms the official Responses schema check, records adopted/adapted/rejected choices and explains why BGSM does not use Pi's single-current-item reducer.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Review docs/plans/agent-provider/pi-source-reference.md and verify its P3 status is no longer Pending.

design.summary: Create a Responses-specific converter and event reducer that emits P1 events while preserving Responses item identity and strict terminal validation.
boundaries: P1 owns SSE, budgets and aggregation.
Agent loop owns tool schema validation and execution.
P5 owns service registration and Options.
contracts: Function calls and outputs retain call_id identity.
Output items are keyed by item ID or output index.
No partial tool call enters ModelResponse.
compatibility: Keep final ModelResponse and prepared request contracts.
Do not use previous_response_id or persisted provider sessions.
Review Pi's converter and reducer, but do not import its SDK path, reasoning/session machinery or single-current-item assumption.
rollout: Implement event conversion and strict termination.
Add fixtures and prepared execution tests.
rollback: Remove the adapter without changing P1 or Chat.
P5 must not register Responses until this bundle is verified.
observability: Record protocol, duration, item/event counts, bytes and terminal category.
Do not log input/output items, tool arguments or credentials.

steps.text: Review the pinned P3 Pi sources, compare them with the current official Responses schema and update the comparison record, including the interleaved-item divergence.
Confirm current Responses request and streaming schemas and implement message/tool conversion.
Implement identity-safe Responses event conversion, usage and strict terminal handling.
Add prepared final aggregation and compatibility tests.

verification.procedure: Compare request conversion fixtures with the current official Responses schema.
Run text, interleaved item, function-call, usage, failed, cancelled, malformed and missing-completed fixtures.
Run prepared request and OrganizeProposalAnalyzer compatibility tests with the Responses adapter.
Run pnpm typecheck and pnpm test:logic.

Verify the P3 comparison record cites the pinned Pi revision and current official Responses schema, explicitly rejects a single mutable currentItem reducer, and confirms no Pi/Node SDK import or persistent provider session was added.

risks.risk: Interleaved output items corrupt one another.
risks.trigger: The parser stores only one current item or block.
risks.mitigation: Key state by provider item identity or output index and validate closure.

risks.risk: An incomplete stream is accepted as success.
risks.trigger: EOF is treated as completion without response.completed.
risks.mitigation: Require the documented success terminal event.

risks.risk: Pi event details are stale, Node-specific or weaker than BGSM's interleaving contract.
risks.trigger: Implementation copies Pi fields or its single-current-item state without official verification.
risks.mitigation: Review Pi as required comparison material, record intentional divergences and confirm current official API/OpenAPI schemas first.
